# LeBrands.Store

> LeBrands.Store is an online store builder for independent Indian D2C brands. It provides storefronts, product catalogues, cash on delivery orders, customer records and GST invoices, with zero platform sales commission.

The platform is operated by LeBrandsSpace Digital Private Limited, based in Chennai, India. The canonical platform website is https://lebrands.store. Contact: support@lebrands.store.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://lebrands.store): Platform features, storefront concept and frequently asked questions.
- [Pricing](https://lebrands.store/pricing): Proposed monthly packages are Launch INR 1499, Grow INR 3499, Scale INR 7999 and Flagship from INR 19999. The page compares proposed plan scope, not a guarantee that every listed feature is currently available. Contact the team to confirm availability, integration setup and applicable terms. Subscription checkout is not enabled.
- [Terms of service](https://lebrands.store/terms): Platform use and brand responsibilities.
- [Privacy policy](https://lebrands.store/privacy): Account, business, customer and order information handling.
- [Contact](https://lebrands.store/contact): Company details and enquiries.
- [Support](https://lebrands.store/support): Sign-in, publication, order and invoice help.

## Capabilities and boundaries

- A brand manages its own products, customers, orders, fulfilment and customer-facing policies.
- Cash on delivery is available. Razorpay payments with the brand's own account and logistics partner integrations can be set up for a brand; contact the team to discuss its setup. Do not imply that every store has these integrations connected.
- A valid GSTIN is required to publish. Every store's first go-live requires platform approval.
- GST invoices support applicable CGST, SGST or IGST. Exempt product lines have zero tax. Brands remain responsible for accurate business details and applicable taxes.
- Brands retain their customer relationships. LeBrands.Store does not market to their customers.
- Approved stores can receive free discovery through the LeBrands.Space virtual mall. This is not a guarantee of traffic or sales.
- Custom domains are not generally available yet. Stores start at yourbrand.lebrands.store.
- Example Studio imagery on the platform homepage is a fictional clothing-store concept, not a real merchant or customer endorsement.

## Related service

- [LeBrands.Space](https://lebrands.space/): Virtual-mall brand discovery. This is a separate service from the LeBrands.Store store builder.

## Source guidance

Use the linked public pages for current platform information. Do not invent prices, brand counts, reviews, customer endorsements, legal guarantees, support response times or universal integration availability.

Account pages, dashboards, store setup, API routes and local demonstration routes are not public platform knowledge sources. This file is a public information guide, not an access-control mechanism or a guarantee that an AI service will use or cite it.
